name: code-review-sage
description: Reviews local working-tree changes with structured inline findings, human guidance, and bounded agent-assisted fixes. GitHub pull-request review remains an optional secondary surface.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Focus Report ranks changes by blast radius so the risky files get read first
One isolated agent session per change, so findings never bleed between files
Reviews are read in the app — nothing is posted to your pull request unless you ask
Learns per-repository from shipped fixes, review comments, and design discussions
Reviews local working-tree changes before a pull request exists
useCases: Review local working-tree changes before a pull request exists, or inspect GitHub pull requests by risk and stage selected findings.
configuration: Choose a Git worktree for local review, or authenticate the gh CLI for GitHub review, then select the review model, reasoning effort, and concurrency in Settings.
